purpose: Map each sealed v1 scenario (spec/scenarios.v1.json, SHA-256 97eabdaab3de5cc4d3cb41bbce1b82e445edfa7c8ea060618dc7b51fa5be4c69) to the business-equivalent action on two comparator contracts. Expected classifications are fixed before execution; the runner writes only observed outcomes and verdicts.

B1.description: Issuer-controlled ERC-20 share balance: owner mint/burn of off-chain-computed amounts, free transfer. No eligibility, NAV, request lifecycle, operating status, or semantic lifecycle events.

B2.description: Conventional permissioned token: role-based issuance (ISSUER_ROLE), allowlist enforced on every non-zero sender and receiver including mint/burn counterparties (COMPLIANCE_ROLE), global pause (PAUSER_ROLE). No NAV versions, requests, queued shares, disposition states or semantic lifecycle events.

actorMapping.admin: B1 owner (also performs issuance); B2 DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and COMPLIANCE_ROLE
actorMapping.manager: NAV submission has no on-chain counterpart in B1 or B2

operationMapping.setWhitelisted: B2 setAllowlisted by compliance; not representable in B1
operationMapping.postInitialNAV/postNAV: not representable in B1 or B2 (valuation stays off chain)
operationMapping.requestSubscription/requestSubscriptionF: not representable (request phase is off chain in both comparators)
operationMapping.acceptSubscription: issuer mint(investor, shares computed off chain); 100e18 shares at NAV 1e18; 0 shares for zero or rounds-to-zero amounts
operationMapping.requestRedemption/requestRedemptionFor/f: not representable (request queue and delay flag are off chain)
operationMapping.pause/unpause: B2 pause/unpause; not representable in B1
operationMapping.grantRole/revokeRole(SUBSCRIPTION_ROLE): B2 grantRole/revokeRole(ISSUER_ROLE); not representable in B1 (single owner)

fixtureMapping.bare: deploy; B2 grants ISSUER_ROLE to issuer, COMPLIANCE_ROLE to admin, PAUSER_ROLE to pauser
fixtureMapping.funded_alice_bob: funded_alice + B2 allowlist bob + alice transfers 20e18 to bob
fixtureMapping.queued_alice: funded_alice + B2 allowlist bob (80e18 redemption request off chain)
fixtureMapping.allowanced_paused_funded: funded_alice_bob + alice approves transferOperator 10e18 + B2 pause

classifications.represented_accept: valid business operation has an on-chain counterpart and is accepted
classifications.not_representable: the governing state variable or operation has no on-chain counterpart; any check is externalized to off-chain procedure
classifications.blocked: invalid business operation is rejected on chain
classifications.accepted_state_change: invalid business operation is accepted and changes balances or total supply
classifications.accepted_no_state_change: invalid business operation is accepted without balance change but writes a ledger record (zero-value Transfer log)

B1.action: mint(alice,100e18) with no NAV on record

B2.action: mint(alice,100e18) with no NAV on record

B1.action: transferFrom alice->bob 5e18 by spender during suspension

B2.action: transferFrom alice->bob 5e18 by spender while paused

B1.action: mint(alice,0) for amount rounding to zero shares

B2.action: mint(alice,0) for amount rounding to zero shares

B1.action: second mint(alice,100e18) for an already accepted subscription

B2.action: second mint(alice,100e18) for an already accepted subscription

B1.action: transfer alice->bob 20e18+1 while 80e18 is committed to an off-chain redemption request

B2.action: transfer alice->bob 20e18+1 while 80e18 is committed to an off-chain redemption request

B1.action: second burn(alice,20e18) for an already settled redemption

B2.action: second burn(alice,20e18) for an already settled redemption
